Summary: Customer Account & Privacy
Description:
Goal: Let anyone browse without an account, ask for one only when it is needed, collect the smallest data set a business needs, and give customers full control of consent and deletion.
Objectives: OBJ-01, OBJ-02
Business need: BN-01
Functional requirements: FR-ACC-01 to FR-ACC-09

Summary: Discovery, Menus & Allergens
Description:
Goal: Get a customer from app launch to the right business page within two taps, show every business with its own look and with neutral ranking, and show complete allergen information before anything can be added.
Objectives: OBJ-03, OBJ-04
Business need: BN-02
Functional requirements: FR-DSC-01 to FR-DSC-09

Summary: Ordering, Pickup & Payments
Description:
Goal: Let a customer order food for pickup in a slot the kitchen can handle, pay securely with bank confirmation, see exactly what VAT they paid, and collect without waiting at the counter.
Objectives: OBJ-01, OBJ-06
Business need: BN-03
Functional requirements: FR-ORD-01 to FR-PAY-09

Summary: Appointment Booking
Description:
Goal: Let a customer book a salon or spa appointment around the clock, offering only start times that really fit the staff member's day, with reminders and self-service changes that cut no-shows.
Objectives: OBJ-02, OBJ-03
Business need: BN-04
Functional requirements: FR-APT-01 to FR-APT-10

Summary: Business Portal & POS
Description:
Goal: Give the business one portal to maintain its catalog, allergens, services and staff hours, and give counter staff a POS view that runs pickup orders and the appointment day without a phone.
Objectives: OBJ-04, OBJ-06
Business need: BN-05
Functional requirements: FR-CAT-01 to FR-POS-09

Summary: Business Onboarding & Platform Administration
Description:
Goal: Take a local business from application to Live in five business days or fewer, with verified identity, payment onboarding, a statement of reasons for every suspension, and a complete audit trail.
Objectives: OBJ-05
Business need: BN-06
Functional requirements: FR-ONB-01 to FR-ONB-09

Summary: Browse as a guest and sign in only when needed
Description:
As a first-time visitor, I want to look at businesses, menus, prices and allergens without creating an account, so that I can decide whether the app is worth signing up for.

Requirements: FR-ACC-01, FR-DSC-08
Business rules: BR-001
Dependencies: None
Test cases: TC-ACC-001, TC-DSC-009
Acceptance Criteria:
Scenario: US-001-AC1 A guest sees the whole menu with prices and allergens
  Given Sophie has opened the app without an account
  When she opens Café Mohnblume and taps "Topfengolatsche"
  Then she sees the price "€ 3,40" and "Enthält: A Glutenhaltiges Getreide, C Eier, G Milch oder Laktose"
  And the Add button reads "Melde dich an, um zu bestellen"

Scenario Outline: US-001-AC2 Actions that need an account open the sign-in prompt
  Given Sophie is a guest
  When she <action>
  Then the sign-in prompt opens and nothing is <result>

  Examples:
    | action                                   | result   |
    | taps Add on an item                      | added    |
    | taps the heart on a business card        | saved    |
    | opens the Bookings tab                   | shown    |
    | taps "Termin buchen" on a salon service  | held     |

Scenario: US-001-AC3 Return to the blocked action after signing in
  Given Sophie tapped the heart on Café Mohnblume as a guest and the sign-in prompt opened
  When she signs in successfully
  Then she is back on the Café Mohnblume card
  And the heart action completes without a second tap

Scenario: US-001-AC4 Save and unsave a location
  Given Sophie is signed in
  When she taps the heart on Café Mohnblume and then on Nudelbar Sesam, Neubau
  Then both locations are listed under Profile, Gespeichert
  When she taps the heart on Café Mohnblume again
  Then only Nudelbar Sesam, Neubau remains saved

  And she ticks "Ich bin 14 Jahre oder älter."
  And she leaves "Marketing-E-Mails" unticked
  And she taps "Registrieren"
  Then the account is created and she is signed in on Home
  And the stored data is exactly first name, last name, email, mobile, password hash, age declaration and locale
  And consents are stored for the terms and privacy versions shown, with marketing email not granted

Scenario Outline: US-002-AC2 Name and password boundaries
  When Sophie enters <field> "<value>" and leaves the field
  Then the result is "<result>"

  Examples:
    | field      | value                                                 | result                                                                   |
    | first name | S                                                     | Bitte gib deinen Vornamen ein (mindestens 2 Buchstaben).                 |
    | first name | Jo                                                    | accepted                                                                 |
    | first name | Anna-Lena O'Brien                                     | accepted                                                                 |
    | first name | Sophie2                                               | Bitte gib deinen Vornamen ein (mindestens 2 Buchstaben).                 |
    | password   | Mohn202                                               | Das Passwort braucht mindestens 8 Zeichen, einen Groß- und einen Kleinbuchstaben und eine Zahl. |
    | password   | Mohn2026                                              | accepted                                                                 |
    | password   | mohn2026                                              | Das Passwort braucht mindestens 8 Zeichen, einen Groß- und einen Kleinbuchstaben und eine Zahl. |
    | password   | Password1                                             | Dieses Passwort ist aus einem Datenleck bekannt. Bitte wähle ein anderes. |

Scenario: US-002-AC3 The age declaration is required

  When Sophie taps "Registrieren" without ticking "Ich bin 14 Jahre oder älter."
  Then no account is created

Scenario Outline: US-002-AC4 Refuse identities that are already in use
  Given <existing>
  When Daniela signs up with <input>
  Then no account is created and she sees "<message>"

  Examples:
    | existing                                                     | input                                   | message                                                            |
    | a customer account uses daniela.costa@example.com            | email daniela.costa@example.com          | An account with this email address already exists. Please sign in. |
    | a customer account uses +43 676 5550123                      | mobile +43 676 5550123                   | This mobile number belongs to another account.           |
    | elif.aydin@mohnblume.example is a Business Web Portal account | email elif.aydin@mohnblume.example      | This email address is registered for a business account. Use a different one for the app.                      |

Scenario: US-002-AC5 Marketing consent is separate from the terms
  Given Sophie signs up and ticks "Marketing-E-Mails"
  Then a consent record "marketing_email, granted, source sign_up" is stored with the current privacy notice version
  And accepting the terms does not depend on the marketing tick box

Summary: Sign in with email, Google or Apple
Description:
As a returning customer, I want to sign in with my email and password or with my Google or Apple account, so that I can get to my bookings quickly on any phone.

Requirements: FR-ACC-03
Business rules: BR-004
Dependencies: US-002
Test cases: TC-ACC-004
Acceptance Criteria:
Scenario: US-003-AC1 Sign in with email and password
  Given Daniela has an account with password "Lisboa2026!"
  When she enters her email and that password and taps "Sign in"
  Then she lands on Home with the greeting "Hi Daniela"

Scenario Outline: US-003-AC2 Lock password sign-in after 5 consecutive failures
  Given Daniela has made <failures> consecutive failed password attempts
  When she enters a wrong password again
  Then the result is "<result>"

  Examples:
    | failures | result                                                                            |
    | 3        | Incorrect email address or password.                                              |
    | 4        | Password sign-in is paused for 15 minutes. Reset your password or continue with Google or Apple.         |

Scenario Outline: US-003-AC3 Lock lasts 15 minutes
  Given Daniela's password sign-in was locked at 08:00:00
  When she signs in with the correct password at <time>
  Then the result is "<result>"

  Examples:
    | time     | result                     |
    | 08:14:59 | still locked               |
    | 08:15:00 | signed in                  |

Scenario: US-003-AC4 Same message for an unknown email and a wrong password
  When someone signs in with "nobody@example.com" and any password
  Then the message is "Incorrect email address or password."
  And the response time does not differ from a wrong password for an existing account by more than 50 ms on average over 100 attempts

Scenario: US-003-AC5 Sign in with Apple on iOS, not offered on Android
  Given Sophie uses an iPhone and Daniela uses an Android phone
  Then Sophie sees "Weiter mit Google" and "Weiter mit Apple"
  And Daniela sees "Continue with Google" only
  When Sophie signs in with Apple using a verified email that matches no account
  Then the app asks for her mobile number and the age declaration before the account is created

Summary: Reset a forgotten password with a code
Description:
As a customer who has forgotten my password, I want a code by email to set a new one, so that I can get back into my account without calling support.

Requirements: FR-ACC-04
Business rules: BR-004
Dependencies: US-003
Test cases: TC-ACC-005
Acceptance Criteria:
Scenario: US-004-AC1 Request a code without revealing whether the account exists
  When Sophie requests a code for "sophie.wallner@example.com"
  And someone else requests a code for "unknown@example.com"
  Then both see "Wenn es ein Konto mit dieser E-Mail-Adresse gibt, haben wir dir einen Code geschickt."
  And only Sophie receives an email with a 6-digit code

Scenario Outline: US-004-AC2 The code is valid for 10 minutes
  Given a code was sent to Sophie at 19:00:00
  When she enters it at <time>
  Then the result is "<result>"

  Examples:
    | time     | result                                                  |
    | 19:09:59 | accepted                                                |
    | 19:10:00 | Der Code ist abgelaufen. Bitte fordere einen neuen an.  |

Scenario: US-004-AC3 Five wrong attempts invalidate the code
  Given Sophie has a valid code
  When she enters a wrong code 4 times
  Then she sees "Der Code ist nicht korrekt. Noch 1 Versuch." after the fourth attempt
  When she enters a wrong code a fifth time
  Then she sees "Zu viele Versuche. Bitte fordere einen neuen Code an."
  And the correct code no longer works

Scenario Outline: US-004-AC4 Resend after 60 seconds invalidates the earlier code
  Given the first code was sent at 19:00:00
  When Sophie taps "Code erneut senden" at <time>
  Then the result is "<result>"

  Examples:
    | time     | result                                                                     |
    | 19:00:59 | control disabled showing "Neuer Code in 0:01"                              |
    | 19:01:00 | a new code is sent; the first code is rejected as not correct              |

Scenario: US-004-AC5 Saving the new password ends other sessions
  Given Sophie is signed in on her iPhone and her iPad
  When she completes a reset on the iPhone with the new password "Golatsche7"
  Then the iPad session ends at its next request
  And Sign In shows "Dein Passwort wurde geändert. Bitte melde dich an."
  And reusing the current password as the new password is refused with "Bitte wähle ein Passwort, das du derzeit nicht verwendest."

Summary: Manage my profile, consents and account deletion
Description:
As a customer, I want to change my details, language and notifications, withdraw consents and delete my account myself, so that I stay in control of my data.

Requirements: FR-ACC-06, FR-ACC-07, FR-ACC-08, FR-ACC-09
Business rules: BR-003, BR-005, BR-041
Dependencies: US-002
Test cases: TC-ACC-006, TC-ACC-007, TC-ACC-008, TC-ACC-009
Acceptance Criteria:
Scenario: US-005-AC1 Switch language and push notifications
  Given Daniela uses the app in German
  When she selects "English" in Profile and switches order and appointment push notifications off
  Then the app shows English immediately without a restart
  And her next order confirmation still arrives by email

Scenario: US-005-AC2 Withdraw a consent as easily as it was given
  Given Daniela granted analytics and marketing email
  When she switches both off in Profile, Privacy
  Then new consent records "analytics, not granted" and "marketing_email, not granted" are stored with timestamp and source "profile"
  And the analytics SDK stops sending events in the same session

Scenario Outline: US-005-AC3 Account deletion is refused while something is open
  Given Daniela has <open item>
  When she requests deletion and confirms with her password
  Then the result is "<result>"

  Examples:
    | open item                                                       | result                                                              |
    | an order in status Ready                                        | refused: "You still have open orders or appointments."              |
    | an appointment on 2026-10-20 at 10:00                           | refused: "You still have open orders or appointments."              |
    | only completed orders                                           | accepted: "Your account will be deleted within 30 days."            |

Scenario: US-005-AC4 Deleted accounts keep the records the law requires
  Given Daniela's deletion request was accepted on 2026-09-02
  When the deletion job has run, at the latest on 2026-10-02
  Then her name, email, mobile, consents and device tokens are erased
  And her orders, payments and receipts remain under a pseudonymous customer ID for 7 years
  And signing in with her old email fails with "Incorrect email address or password."

Scenario: US-005-AC5 Data export for an access request
  Given Daniela emails support asking for a copy of her data and support verifies her identity
  When Paul Haider runs the export for her account
  Then a JSON file is produced with profile, consents, orders, appointments and saved locations
  And the export is logged in the audit trail with Paul as actor

Summary: Find businesses near me from Home
Description:
As a customer in a hurry at lunchtime, I want Home to show me what is near me and what I already have going, so that I reach the right business page in two taps.

Requirements: FR-DSC-01, FR-DSC-04
Business rules: BR-006, BR-007, BR-008
Dependencies: None
Test cases: TC-DSC-001, TC-DSC-002
Acceptance Criteria:
Scenario: US-006-AC1 Home sections in order for a signed-in customer
  Given Sophie is signed in, has location permission and has an order in status Preparing at Café Mohnblume
  When she opens the app
  Then Home shows, in order: "Hallo Sophie" with the location chip "Neubau", the search bar, the cards "Essen & Trinken", "Haare & Beauty" and "Wellness & Massage", an Ongoing card "Café Mohnblume · In Zubereitung · Abholung 12:15", and Near you
  And Near you lists Café Mohnblume (0,4 km), Haarstudio Linde (0,6 km), Nudelbar Sesam Neubau (0,7 km), Konditorei Pomeranze (1,1 km), Massageatelier Ruhepol (2,4 km) in that order

Scenario: US-006-AC2 Without location permission, sorting falls back to name and the header states it
  Given Sophie has denied location permission
  When she opens Home
  Then Near you is swapped for a card "Standort aktivieren, um Geschäfte in deiner Nähe zu sehen"
  And "Alle anzeigen" opens a list headed "5 Geschäfte · sortiert nach Name" starting with "Café Mohnblume"

Scenario Outline: US-006-AC3 Open state is always in words
  Given Café Mohnblume opens 07:30 to 18:00 on Thursday 2026-09-17
  When Sophie looks at the card at <time>
  Then the card shows "<label>"

  Examples:
    | time  | label             |
    | 07:29 | Öffnet um 07:30   |
    | 07:30 | Geöffnet bis 18:00 |
    | 17:59 | Geöffnet bis 18:00 |
    | 18:00 | Heute geschlossen |

Scenario: US-006-AC4 Cards carry no ratings, scores or sponsored markers
  When Sophie looks at any business card in Home, a listing or search
  Then the card shows logo or initials, name, type, distance, open state and the heart only
  And no element on the card shows stars, a score, a review count or "Empfohlen"

Summary: Search for a business, dish or service
Description:

Description:
As a customer who wants "a bakery near me", I want to filter a category by business type and open status, so that I see only places I can use now.

Dependencies: US-006

As a customer with a tree-nut allergy, I want to see an item's allergens, and those added by each choice, before I can add it, and I want to mark items I must avoid, so that I never order something I cannot eat by accident.

Test cases: TC-DSC-004, TC-DSC-008

Scenario: US-010-AC1 Allergens shown above the options and never collapsed
  When Daniela opens "Linsen-Bowl" at Café Mohnblume
  Then the popup shows "Contains: L Celery. Depending on your choice also: H Tree nuts, N Sesame." above the option group "Topping"
  And the choice "Cashew topping + € 0.90" shows "H" and "Sesame topping + € 0.50" shows "N"

Scenario Outline: US-010-AC2 Declaration states
  When Daniela opens "<item>"
  Then the allergen line reads "<text>"

  Examples:
    | item                    | text                                                          |
    | Topfengolatsche         | Contains: A Cereals containing gluten, C Eggs, G Milk or lactose |

    | Nussschnecke            | Contains: A Cereals containing gluten, C Eggs, G Milk or lactose, H Tree nuts |

Scenario: US-010-AC3 Reference sheet of all 14 allergens
  When Daniela taps the information control next to the allergen line
  Then a sheet lists A, B, C, D, E, F, G, H, L, M, N, O, P, R with their names
  And it ends with "If you have a severe allergy, also speak to the business about traces."

Scenario Outline: US-010-AC4 Allergen filter marks items and never says safe
  Given Daniela has set the filter to avoid "H Tree nuts"
  When she opens the Café Mohnblume menu
  Then the row "<item>" shows "<marking>"

  Examples:
    | item                  | marking                                    |
    | Nussschnecke          | dimmed, "Contains H"                       |
    | Linsen-Bowl           | not dimmed, "Depending on choice: H"       |

Scenario: US-010-AC5 The filter stays on the phone
  Given Daniela has set the filter to avoid H

  Then no API request, analytics event or error report contains her filter selection
  And after she reinstalls the app the filter is empty

Scenario: US-010-AC6 Allergens that changed are shown as current within 60 seconds
  Given Daniela is viewing Konditorei Pomeranze, where "Topfentorte (Stück)" shows "A C G"
  When the Business Admin of Konditorei Pomeranze confirms version 4 with "A C G H" at 08:52:00
  Then a refreshed menu at 08:53:00 shows "A C G H"

Business rules: BR-016

Test cases: TC-ORD-001

Summary: Pay by card or wallet with bank confirmation
Description:
As a customer, I want to pay in the app with my card, Apple Pay or Google Pay and confirm with my bank, so that the order is paid and I am charged only if the café accepts it.

Requirements: FR-PAY-01, FR-PAY-02, FR-PAY-03, FR-PAY-09
Business rules: BR-024, BR-032, BR-033
Dependencies: US-012, US-035
Test cases: TC-PAY-001, TC-PAY-002, TC-PAY-007, TC-PAY-009
Acceptance Criteria:
Scenario: US-013-AC1 Authorise at placement, capture at acceptance
  Given Sophie places an order of € 15,70 with the sandbox card ending 3155
  When she completes the 3-D Secure challenge
  Then the order is Placed and Booking Details shows "Zahlung reserviert, wird bei Annahme abgebucht"
  When Tobias accepts the order on the order board
  Then € 15,70 is captured with an application fee of € 1,51
  And Booking Details shows "Bezahlt mit Karte •••• 3155"

Scenario: US-013-AC2 Rejection voids the authorization
  Given an order is Placed with an authorized payment
  When Tobias rejects it with the reason "Artikel ausverkauft"
  Then the authorization is voided and nothing is captured
  And Sophie sees "Reservierung aufgehoben, es wurde nichts abgebucht"

Scenario: US-013-AC3 Card data never reaches the platform
  When Sophie enters her card in checkout
  Then the card number is entered in the card payment provider's hosted field
  And no the platform API request, log line or error event contains the card number

Scenario Outline: US-013-AC4 Pay at pickup only where the business offers it
  Given <business> has pay at pickup <setting>
  When Sophie opens the payment methods
  Then "Bezahlung bei Abholung" is <shown>

  Examples:
    | business            | setting  | shown     |
    | Café Mohnblume      | enabled  | shown     |
    | Nudelbar Sesam      | disabled | not shown |

Scenario: US-013-AC5 A declined payment creates no order
  When Sophie's bank declines the 3-D Secure challenge
  Then no order is created
  And she sees "Die Zahlung wurde nicht bestätigt. Es wurde nichts abgebucht."
  And her slot hold remains until it expires

Scenario: US-013-AC6 Webhooks are processed once
  Given the card payment provider sends "payment.authorized" for the order twice with the same event ID
  Then the order is created once and the second delivery is answered 200 and ignored

Summary: See a VAT-inclusive total with a voucher
Description:
As a customer, I want to see the total I will pay, the effect of my voucher and how much VAT the total includes before I pay, so that there are no surprises on my receipt.

Requirements: FR-ORD-04, FR-PAY-05, FR-PAY-06
Business rules: BR-015, BR-035, BR-036
Dependencies: US-011
Test cases: TC-ORD-004, TC-PAY-003, TC-PAY-004
Acceptance Criteria:
Scenario: US-014-AC1 Canonical basket with voucher MOHN3
  Given Sophie's cart at Café Mohnblume holds 2 x Topfengolatsche at € 3,40, 1 x Schinken-Käse-Sandwich at € 6,90 and 1 x Hausgemachte Limonade 0,5 l at € 5,00
  When she enters the voucher code "MOHN3"
  Then checkout shows subtotal € 18,70, voucher "MOHN3" − € 3,00 and total € 15,70
  And "darin enthalten" shows USt. 10 %: € 1,05 and USt. 20 %: € 0,70
  And the order button reads "Zahlungspflichtig bestellen · € 15,70"

Scenario: US-014-AC2 The voucher is split across the VAT rates
  Given the basket of AC1 with MOHN3
  Then the quote allocates € 2,20 of the discount to the 10 % group and € 0,80 to the 20 % group
  And the 10 % group is € 11,50 gross, € 10,45 net, € 1,05 VAT
  And the 20 % group is € 4,20 gross, € 3,50 net, € 0,70 VAT

Scenario Outline: US-014-AC3 Minimum order value is measured before the discount
  Given Sophie's basket gross is <gross>
  When she enters "MOHN3"
  Then the result is "<result>"

  Examples:
    | gross   | result                                                      |
    | € 14,99 | Dieser Gutschein gilt ab einem Bestellwert von € 15,00.     |
    | € 15,00 | applied, total € 12,00                                      |

Scenario Outline: US-014-AC4 Voucher rejections
  When Sophie enters "<code>"
  Then she sees "<message>"

  Examples:
    | code     | message                                         |
    | MOHN33   | Diesen Gutscheincode gibt es nicht.             |
    | SOMMER25 | Dieser Gutschein ist derzeit nicht gültig.      |
    | SESAM5   | Dieser Gutschein gilt nicht für Café Mohnblume. |

Scenario: US-014-AC5 Seller identity is shown before paying
  Then above the order button checkout shows "Verkäufer: Mohnblume Kaffeehaus e.U., Kornblumengasse 9, 1070 Wien"

Summary: Follow my order and collect it
Description:
As a customer, I want to see my order move from placed to ready and pick it up with a code, so that I do not wait at the counter or ask whether it is ready.

Requirements: FR-ORD-05, FR-ORD-06, FR-ORD-07, FR-ORD-09
Business rules: BR-021, BR-022, BR-024, BR-041
Dependencies: US-013, US-026
Test cases: TC-ORD-006, TC-ORD-007, TC-ORD-013
Acceptance Criteria:
Scenario: US-015-AC1 Confirmation with pickup code
  When Sophie's order QO-2026-004218 is Placed at 11:53:30
  Then Booking Details shows "Bestellt", the slot "12:15 - 12:30" and the pickup code "K7PM" with a QR code
  And she receives a confirmation email with the order lines and total

Scenario Outline: US-015-AC2 Acceptance timeout of 5 minutes
  Given the order was Placed at 11:53:30
  When Tobias taps "Annehmen" at <time>
  Then the result is "<result>"

  Examples:
    | time     | result                                                                         |
    | 11:58:29 | Accepted; payment captured                                                     |
    | 11:58:30 | refused, the order was auto-rejected with "Keine Antwort vom Geschäft" and voided |

Scenario: US-015-AC3 Live status and push
  Given the order is Accepted
  When Tobias marks it Preparing and then Ready
  Then Booking Details updates within 3 seconds each time without a refresh
  And Sophie receives the push "Café Mohnblume: Deine Bestellung ist fertig"

Scenario: US-015-AC4 A delay is announced
  Given the order is Preparing for slot 12:15
  When Tobias delays it by 15 minutes
  Then Sophie sees "Neue Abholzeit ca. 12:30" and receives a push

Scenario: US-015-AC5 Bookings list
  Given Sophie has one Ready order and two Completed orders
  Then Upcoming shows the Ready order with "Fertig zur Abholung"
  And Past shows the Completed orders, most recent first, each with "Erneut bestellen"

Summary: Cancel an order and get my money back
Description:
As a customer whose plans changed, I want to cancel my order in the app while it is still possible, so that I am not charged for food I will not collect.

Requirements: FR-ORD-08, FR-PAY-04
Business rules: BR-023, BR-034
Dependencies: US-015
Test cases: TC-ORD-008, TC-PAY-005
Acceptance Criteria:
Scenario: US-016-AC1 Cancel while Placed voids the authorization
  Given Sophie's order is Placed with an authorized payment
  When she taps "Bestellung stornieren" and confirms
  Then the order is Canceled, slot capacity is released and the authorization is voided

Scenario Outline: US-016-AC2 Cancel an Accepted order until the cutoff
  Given Sophie's order for slot 12:15 is Accepted and captured, and the cutoff is 30 minutes
  When she tries to cancel at <time>
  Then the result is "<result>"

  Examples:
    | time  | result                                                                        |
    | 11:45 | Canceled; € 15,70 refunded automatically                                      |
    | 11:46 | Cancel not shown; "Bitte ruf Café Mohnblume an: +43 1 5234567"                  |

Scenario: US-016-AC3 Never after preparation started
  Given the order is Preparing at 11:30
  Then the cancel action is not shown, although the cutoff has not passed

Scenario: US-016-AC4 The dialog states how the money comes back
  Given the order is Accepted and captured
  When Sophie taps "Bestellung stornieren"
  Then the dialog reads "Du bekommst € 15,70 auf deine Karte zurück. Die Gutschrift dauert 5 bis 10 Werktage."

Summary: Rebook a past order
Description:
As a regular, I want to order the same lunch again with one tap, so that I do not rebuild it item by item.

Requirements: FR-ORD-10
Business rules: BR-025
Dependencies: US-015
Test cases: TC-ORD-009
Acceptance Criteria:
Scenario: US-017-AC1 Rebook copies items at today's prices
  Given Sophie's Completed order had 1 x Linsen-Bowl with "Sesam-Topping" at € 10,30
  And the Linsen-Bowl now costs € 10,20, so the configured line costs € 10,70
  When she taps "Erneut bestellen"
  Then the Café Mohnblume page opens with the cart bar "1 Artikel · € 10,70"
  And she sees "Einige Preise haben sich seit deiner letzten Bestellung geändert."

Scenario: US-017-AC2 Unavailable items are skipped and listed
  Given the past order had 2 items and "Mohnkuchen" is no longer published
  When Sophie rebooks
  Then 1 item is added and she sees "1 Artikel ist nicht mehr verfügbar und wurde nicht hinzugefügt."

Scenario: US-017-AC3 Slot, note, voucher and payment are not copied
  When Sophie rebooks
  Then the checkout has no slot, no note, no voucher and the default payment method

Scenario: US-017-AC4 No rebook on an order still in progress
  Given an order is Preparing
  Then its card shows no "Erneut bestellen"

Summary: Pre-order a whole cake for a later day
Description:
As a customer planning a birthday, I want to order a whole cake for a later day, so that the bakery can make it in time.

Requirements: FR-ORD-11
Business rules: BR-017
Dependencies: US-012
Test cases: TC-ORD-007, TC-ORD-012
Acceptance Criteria:
Scenario Outline: US-018-AC1 Earliest slot follows the 48-hour lead time
  Given Daniela adds "Schokoladentorte, ganz" (lead time 48 hours) at Konditorei Pomeranze on Monday 2026-09-14 at 10:00
  When she opens slot selection
  Then the slot "<slot>" is <offered>

  Examples:
    | slot                      | offered     |
    | Wed 2026-09-16 09:45      | not offered |
    | Wed 2026-09-16 10:00      | offered     |
    | Mon 2026-09-21 10:00      | offered     |
    | Mon 2026-09-21 10:15      | not offered |

Scenario: US-018-AC2 The largest lead time in the cart governs
  Given the cart holds "Schokoladentorte, ganz" (48 hours) and "Topfentorte (Stück)" (no lead time)
  Then no same-day slot is offered

Scenario: US-018-AC3 A pre-order placed while closed is accepted after opening
  Given Daniela places the pre-order on Monday 2026-09-14 at 20:10 and Pomeranze opens on Tuesday at 06:30
  Then the order's acceptance deadline is Tuesday 2026-09-15 07:00
  And it is not auto-rejected overnight

Summary: Get a receipt in the business's name
Description:
As a customer, I want an itemized receipt from the business with the VAT shown, so that I can claim business lunches and check what I paid.

Requirements: FR-PAY-07
Business rules: BR-038
Dependencies: US-013
Test cases: TC-PAY-006, TC-PAY-010
Acceptance Criteria:
Scenario: US-019-AC1 Receipt content for the canonical order
  Given order QO-2026-004218 for € 15,70 was captured
  Then a receipt is emailed and shown under "Beleg" in Booking Details
  And it states seller "Mohnblume Kaffeehaus e.U.", "Kornblumengasse 9, 1070 Wien", UID "ATU71234567"
  And it lists the 3 lines, the voucher − € 3,00, total € 15,70
  And for 10 %: gross € 11,50, net € 10,45, VAT € 1,05; for 20 %: gross € 4,20, net € 3,50, VAT € 0,70
  And it carries "Vermittelt über die Plattform"

Scenario Outline: US-019-AC2 In-app payment is limited to € 400,00
  Given a catering order totals <total>
  When Sophie opens checkout
  Then in-app payment is <state>

  Examples:
    | total    | state                                                                     |
    | € 400,00 | available                                                                 |
    | € 400,01 | unavailable: "In der App kannst du Bestellungen bis € 400,00 bezahlen."    |

Scenario: US-019-AC3 Small-business exemption
  Given Kaffeebar Zimtstern applies the small-business VAT exemption
  When Sophie's order of 2 x Espresso at € 2,60 is captured
  Then the receipt shows total € 5,20 and "Umsatzsteuerbefreit, Kleinunternehmer"
  And it shows no VAT amounts

Summary: Be told what changed before I pay
Description:
As a customer with an allergy, I want checkout to stop me if an item's allergens or price changed after I added it, and to offer me another time if my slot filled while my bank confirmed the payment, so that I never pay for something different from what I chose.

Requirements: FR-ORD-12
Business rules: BR-013, BR-019, BR-020
Dependencies: US-013, US-029
Test cases: TC-ORD-010, TC-ORD-011
Acceptance Criteria:
Scenario: US-020-AC1 Allergens added since the item was added
  Given Daniela added "Topfentorte (Stück)" at 08:40 when its declaration was version 3 (A C G)
  And the bakery confirmed version 4 (A C G H) at 08:52
  When she taps "Zahlungspflichtig bestellen" at 09:05
  Then payment does not start
  And the line expands showing "Neu: H Schalenfrüchte" in bold
  And she must tick "Neue Allergenangaben gelesen" before the order button is enabled again

Scenario: US-020-AC2 Price changed since the item was added
  Given the Linsen-Bowl was € 9,80 in the cart and is now € 10,20
  When Sophie taps the order button
  Then she sees "Der Preis für „Linsen-Bowl“ hat sich geändert: jetzt € 10,20" and the new total, and must confirm

Scenario: US-020-AC3 The hold is extended once when the bank challenge starts
  Given Sophie's hold on 12:15 was created at 11:40:00 and would expire at 11:50:00
  When the card payment provider reports the 3-D Secure challenge started at 11:43:10
  Then the hold expires at 11:55:00
  And a second challenge start does not extend it again

Scenario: US-020-AC4 The slot filled while the bank confirmed
  Given Sophie's hold on 12:15 expired at 11:55:00 and another order took the last unit at 11:55:30
  When her bank confirms the payment at 11:56:20
  Then no order is created in 12:15
  And she sees "Deine Abholzeit ist inzwischen ausgebucht. Wähle eine neue Zeit, deine Zahlung bleibt reserviert." with 12:30, 12:45 and 13:00 held for 3 minutes
  When she chooses 12:30 at 11:57:40
  Then the order is Placed in 12:30 using the same authorization

Scenario: US-020-AC5 No choice within 3 minutes
  Given alternatives were offered at 11:56:20
  When Sophie has not chosen by 11:59:20
  Then the authorization is voided and she sees "Reservierung aufgehoben, es wurde nichts abgebucht"

Summary: Choose a service and a staff member
Description:
As a customer, I want to pick the service I need and either my usual stylist or whoever is free, so that I can book the way I prefer.

Requirements: FR-APT-01, FR-APT-02
Business rules: BR-015, BR-026, BR-027
Dependencies: US-031
Test cases: TC-APT-001
Acceptance Criteria:
Scenario: US-021-AC1 Service list
  When Sophie opens Haarstudio Linde
  Then the service list shows "Damenhaarschnitt (Waschen, Schneiden, Föhnen) · 45 Min. · € 52,00"
  And "Ansatzfarbe · 60 Min. · ab € 65,00"

Scenario: US-021-AC2 Only qualified staff can be chosen
  When Sophie chooses "Ansatzfarbe"
  Then the staff choices are "Aylin Demir" and "Beliebig"
  And Lena Auer is not offered

Scenario: US-021-AC3 Beliebig shows the union of start times
  When Sophie chooses "Damenhaarschnitt" with "Beliebig" for 2026-10-13, viewed on 2026-10-12 at 18:00
  Then the start times are Lena's 09:00, 09:15, 09:30, 11:15, 11:30, 11:45, 12:00 and Aylin's 13:00 to 17:00 every 15 minutes

Summary: See only start times that really fit
Description:
As a customer, I want to see only start times at which my whole service, including the stylist's cleanup time, fits, so that I never book a time the salon has to move.

Requirements: FR-APT-02
Business rules: BR-026
Dependencies: US-021
Test cases: TC-APT-002, TC-APT-003
Acceptance Criteria:
Scenario: US-022-AC1 Canonical start times with buffer
  Given Lena works 09:00 to 13:00 on 2026-10-13 and has an appointment occupying 10:30 to 11:15
  When Sophie views "Damenhaarschnitt" (45 minutes plus 15 minutes buffer) with Lena on 2026-10-12 at 18:00
  Then exactly these 7 start times are offered: 09:00, 09:15, 09:30, 11:15, 11:30, 11:45, 12:00

Scenario Outline: US-022-AC2 Boundaries of the occupied interval and the shift
  Given the situation of AC1
  Then the start time <start> is <result> because <reason>

  Examples:
    | start | result      | reason                                                      |
    | 09:30 | offered     | it ends at 10:30, where the existing appointment begins     |
    | 09:45 | not offered | it overlaps 10:30 to 11:15                                  |
    | 11:00 | not offered | it overlaps the buffer that ends at 11:15                   |
    | 11:15 | offered     | it starts exactly when the buffer ends                      |
    | 12:00 | offered     | its buffer ends at 13:00, the end of the shift              |
    | 12:15 | not offered | the service ends at 13:00 but its buffer runs to 13:15      |

Scenario: US-022-AC3 Booking a time removes overlapping start times
  Given the situation of AC1
  When Sophie books 09:30
  Then Lena's start times for the service are 11:15, 11:30, 11:45, 12:00
  And 09:00 and 09:15 are no longer offered

Scenario Outline: US-022-AC4 Minimum notice of 2 hours
  Given it is 2026-10-13 at <now>
  When Sophie views Lena's start times for the same day
  Then the first start time offered is <first>

  Examples:
    | now   | first |
    | 07:15 | 09:15 |
    | 07:16 | 09:30 |

Scenario Outline: US-022-AC5 Booking horizon of 8 weeks
  Given it is 2026-10-12
  When Sophie opens the date <date>
  Then the date is <state>

  Examples:
    | date       | state        |
    | 2026-12-07 | bookable     |
    | 2026-12-08 | not bookable |

Summary: Hold and confirm my appointment
Description:
As a customer, I want my chosen time kept for me while I confirm, and a confirmation I can put in my calendar, so that I know the appointment is mine.

Requirements: FR-APT-03, FR-APT-04, FR-APT-08, FR-APT-09
Business rules: BR-027, BR-028, BR-032
Dependencies: US-022
Test cases: TC-APT-004, TC-APT-005, TC-APT-006
Acceptance Criteria:
Scenario: US-023-AC1 Hold and confirm
  Given Sophie selects Lena at 09:30 on 2026-10-13 at 18:02 on 2026-10-12
  Then the screen shows "Termin reserviert · 10:00"
  And above the button "€ 52,00 · Bezahlung vor Ort"
  When she adds the note "Bitte nur Spitzen schneiden" and taps "Zahlungspflichtig buchen"
  Then the appointment is Confirmed for 09:30 to 10:15
  And she receives a confirmation email with a calendar file

Scenario Outline: US-023-AC2 Hold expiry
  Given Sophie selected the time at 18:02:00
  When she taps "Zahlungspflichtig buchen" at <time>
  Then the result is "<result>"

  Examples:
    | time     | result                                                                      |
    | 18:11:59 | Confirmed                                                                   |
    | 18:12:00 | "Deine Reservierung ist abgelaufen. Bitte wähle die Uhrzeit erneut."        |

Scenario: US-023-AC3 Two customers, one time
  Given two requests to confirm Lena at 09:30 reach the server at the same moment
  Then exactly one appointment is Confirmed
  And the other customer sees "Dieser Termin ist leider nicht mehr frei. Nächste freie Zeiten: 11:15, 11:30, 11:45."

Scenario: US-023-AC4 Beliebig assigns the staff member with fewer booked minutes
  Given on 2026-10-14 Lena has 120 booked minutes and Aylin 60, and both can do 14:00
  When Sophie books "Herrenhaarschnitt" at 14:00 with "Beliebig"
  Then Aylin is assigned

Scenario Outline: US-023-AC5 Note length
  When Sophie enters a note of <length> characters
  Then the result is "<result>"

  Examples:
    | length | result                                         |
    | 300    | accepted                                       |
    | 301    | Bitte kürze deine Anmerkung auf 300 Zeichen.   |

Summary: Get a reminder and reschedule or cancel
Description:
As a customer, I want a reminder the day before and the option to move or cancel myself, so that I do not forget and do not have to call during opening hours.

Requirements: FR-APT-05, FR-APT-06
Business rules: BR-029, BR-041
Dependencies: US-023
Test cases: TC-APT-007, TC-APT-008
Acceptance Criteria:
Scenario: US-024-AC1 Reminder 24 hours before
  Given Sophie's appointment is on 2026-10-13 at 09:30
  Then at 2026-10-12 09:30 she receives an email and a push "Morgen 09:30: Damenhaarschnitt bei Haarstudio Linde"
  And both contain links to reschedule or cancel

Scenario: US-024-AC2 No reminder for a short-notice booking
  Given an appointment for 2026-10-13 at 15:00 was booked on 2026-10-13 at 08:00
  Then no reminder is sent, only the confirmation

Scenario Outline: US-024-AC3 Free cancellation until 24 hours before
  Given the appointment is on 2026-10-13 at 09:30
  When Sophie tries to cancel on 2026-10-12 at <time>
  Then the result is "<result>"

  Examples:
    | time  | result                                                                                       |
    | 09:30 | Canceled free of charge                                                                     |
    | 09:31 | "Online-Änderungen sind bis 24 Stunden vor dem Termin möglich. Bitte ruf Haarstudio Linde an: +43 1 5267788." |

Scenario: US-024-AC4 Reschedule is atomic
  Given Sophie reschedules her 09:30 appointment to 11:30 on the same day
  When the new time is confirmed
  Then the 09:30 appointment is Canceled and the 11:30 appointment is Confirmed in the same transaction
  When instead 11:30 is taken before she confirms
  Then her 09:30 appointment stays Confirmed

Scenario: US-024-AC5 Reminders do not depend on push
  Given Sophie switched push notifications off
  Then the reminder still arrives by email

Summary: Check in, complete or mark a no-show
Description:
As a salon owner, I want to run the appointment day from the POS view and record who came, so that the diary stays true and no-shows are counted fairly.

Requirements: FR-APT-07, FR-APT-10, FR-POS-06
Business rules: BR-030, BR-031
Dependencies: US-023
Test cases: TC-APT-009, TC-APT-010, TC-POS-010
Acceptance Criteria:
Scenario: US-025-AC1 Day view
  When Martina opens the appointment day view for 2026-10-13
  Then Lena's column shows 09:30 Sophie W. "Damenhaarschnitt" with the note "Bitte nur Spitzen schneiden" and 10:30 "Herrenhaarschnitt"

Scenario: US-025-AC2 Check in and complete
  Given Sophie arrives at 09:27
  When Martina taps "Eingecheckt" and later "Abgeschlossen"
  Then the appointment moves Confirmed to Checked in to Completed and Sophie's app shows "Abgeschlossen"

Scenario Outline: US-025-AC3 No-show only from 15 minutes after the start
  Given the 09:30 appointment is Confirmed and the customer has not arrived
  When Martina taps "Nicht erschienen" at <time>
  Then the result is "<result>"

  Examples:
    | time  | result                    |
    | 09:44 | "Erst ab 09:45 möglich."  |
    | 09:45 | No-show recorded          |

Scenario: US-025-AC4 Business cancellation needs a reason and informs the customer
  Given Lena is ill on 2026-10-13
  When Martina cancels Sophie's 09:30 appointment with the reason "Mitarbeiterin erkrankt"
  Then Sophie receives a push and an email with the reason and a link to book again
  And canceling without a reason is refused with "Bitte wählen Sie einen Grund."

Summary: Run the order board at the counter
Description:
As counter staff, I want new orders to appear and alert me on one screen with everything I need to prepare them, so that I can accept them quickly without picking up a phone.

Requirements: FR-POS-01, FR-POS-02, FR-POS-07, FR-POS-09
Business rules: BR-012, BR-022, BR-033, BR-039, BR-040
Dependencies: US-013
Test cases: TC-POS-001, TC-POS-002, TC-POS-006, TC-POS-008
Acceptance Criteria:
Scenario: US-026-AC1 New order alert until acted on
  Given the order board for Café Mohnblume is open on the counter tablet
  When order QO-2026-004218 is placed at 11:53:30
  Then within 3 seconds a ticket appears in "Neu" with a sound and a flashing border
  And the ticket shows "Annehmen bis 11:58:30" counting down
  And the sound repeats every 10 seconds until Tobias accepts or rejects

Scenario: US-026-AC2 The ticket shows what the kitchen needs
  Then the ticket shows "Sophie", "Abholung 12:15", "2 x Topfengolatsche (A C G)", "1 x Schinken-Käse-Sandwich (A G M)", "1 x Hausgemachte Limonade · 0,5 l · Holunder" and "In-App-Zahlung"

Scenario: US-026-AC3 Configured lines show the allergens of the configuration
  Given an order line "Linsen-Bowl · Cashew-Topping"
  Then the ticket shows the allergens "L H" for that line

Scenario: US-026-AC4 Accept captures, reject needs a reason
  When Tobias taps "Annehmen"
  Then the order moves to "In Zubereitung" column as Accepted and the payment is captured
  When on another order he taps "Ablehnen" without choosing a reason
  Then the action is refused with "Bitte wählen Sie einen Grund."

Scenario: US-026-AC5 Staff cannot open Business Admin functions
  Given Tobias is signed in with the Staff role
  Then the portal shows only "Bestellungen", "Ausverkauft", "Pause" and "Termine heute"
  And a direct call to PUT /business/items/{itemId} with his token returns 403 FORBIDDEN_FOR_ROLE

Summary: Hand over an order with the pickup code
Description:
As counter staff, I want to match the customer's pickup code before I hand over, so that the right person gets the right bag.

Requirements: FR-POS-03, FR-POS-08
Business rules: BR-021, BR-024
Dependencies: US-026
Test cases: TC-POS-003, TC-POS-004, TC-POS-009
Acceptance Criteria:
Scenario: US-027-AC1 Hand over with the matching code
  Given QO-2026-004218 is Ready with pickup code "K7PM"
  When Sophie shows "K7PM" and Tobias types it
  Then the order is Completed

Scenario: US-027-AC2 Wrong code
  When Tobias types "K7PN"
  Then he sees "Code stimmt nicht. Bitte noch einmal prüfen." and the order stays Ready

Summary: Declare allergens for items and choices
